description: This script is a Python-based linter adapter for checking the consistency of pyproject.toml files, including validation of Python version requirements and classifiers.

classes.name: LintSeverity
classes.description: Enumeration of severity levels for lint messages.

classes.name: LintMessage
classes.description: Data structure representing a lint message with details about the issue.

methods.name: format_error_message
methods.description: Creates a LintMessage object for reporting errors encountered during file parsing or validation.

methods.name: check_file
methods.description: Reads and validates a pyproject.toml file, returning a list of lint messages if issues are found.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to parse arguments, set up logging, and run the file checks concurrently.
